records.title: 10-K
records.text: In fiscal year 2021, our revenue increased by $76.9 million, or 14.5%, to $606.9 million from $530.0 million for fiscal year 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •continued growth in the demand for high-performance analog, digital and optical semiconductors in our three primary markets;

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase in gross profit during 2020 was primarily the result of lower inventory reserve expenses and the strategic realignment of our business under the 2019 Plan (as defined below), resulting in lower compensation-related costs and intangible amortization.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Gross margin of 56.3% in fiscal year 2021 increased 530 basis points, compared to fiscal year 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our cash flow from operating activities for fiscal year 2021 was $148.4 million and consisted of a net income of $38.0 million, plus adjustments to reconcile our net income to cash provided by operating activities of $136.4 million, partially offset by changes in operating assets and liabilities of $25.9 million.
